==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
This dream shares a lot of similarities with my last dream. Arguably it is more technical and less surreal than my last dream. It involves me talking to a digital version of myself.

This time I don't feel like I am in two places at once. The digital version of me is clearly a distinct entity this time. It exists in a chat window on a normal computer screen.

It surprises me, because it seems to have the ability to change its data source on the fly. It essentially can jump to any folder on my computer autonomously to answer questions. I am both impressed and concerned.
